goals.1: Canary Values: abuse the pointer-underflow in vortex1 to overwrite the high byte of a stack pointer so the program's exit path lands in attacker-controlled data, yielding a vortex2 shell to read /etc/vortex_pass/vortex2. NOTE: published passwords for this level could not be verified by login (all stale) — chain blocked here; see vortex-writeup.md.
